io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.utils.compatibility

Interface Tag<T>

  • Type Parameters:
    T - The type contained in this Tag, usually Material
    All Known Implementing Classes:
    SlimefunTag

    public interface Tag<T>
    Version-independent replacement for org.bukkit.Tag.

    The real org.bukkit.Tag interface is declared as Tag<T extends Keyed> and only exists from Minecraft 1.13 onwards. On the 1.8.8 API floor that this project compiles against, Material does not implement Keyed, so SlimefunTag implements Tag<Material> cannot be expressed against the real type. This compat interface drops the Keyed bound and is therefore usable on every supported version.

    The vanilla tag constants below resolve to the server's real org.bukkit.Tag values reflectively on modern servers (so modern versions keep the complete, up-to-date tag contents) and fall back to a name-based Material set on legacy versions where the tag system is absent.

      • lookup

        static Tag<org.bukkit.Material> lookup(java.lang.String registry,
                                       java.lang.String key)
        Looks up a vanilla Minecraft Tag by registry and key, returning a snapshot wrapped as a compat Tag. Returns null when the tag does not exist (or on legacy versions without the tag system).
        Parameters:
        registry - Either REGISTRY_ITEMS or REGISTRY_BLOCKS
        key - The key portion of the tag (e.g. "logs")
        Returns:
        A compat Tag snapshot, or null if unavailable
